title: Stretchable and self-healing polyurethane coating with synergistic anticorrosion effect for the corrosion protection of stainless steels
notes: Spine: need -> barrier+inhibitor+DA hypothesis -> mPU host, F-d@Ce/F-d@MX fillers, wt% sweep -> filler functionalisation -> casting on steel -> DA crosslinked network (n8) and filler shapes (n10) -> branch A: labyrinth barrier (n13) + Ce inhibition (n14) explain corrosion resistance (n15) -> 60-day PCM2 service (n17) -> down-select PCM2 (n18) -> branch B: sunlight on scratch (n19) -> photothermal DA re-formation (n20) -> scratch closed (n22) -> anticorrosion recovered (n24) -> conclusion. Side: filler shells (n9), tensile (n11, n12), thermal (n16). One audit: a1 (no resolved 732 cm-1 furan dip in F-d@Ce qualifies n8, n9). Not in graph: healing efficiency >98%/>90% (Fig S2, text only), TEM and zeta potential (SI), 100-day values (no figure), F3a XRD (caption only, not argued). Judge: n17 has two causes edges (n15, n15b), mode joint. Packet issues: F7 caption (a-e: stress-strain c, Bode d, illustration e) does not match the image (a POM, b SEM, c Bode, d schematic); sunlight 0.5 W/cm2 in caption vs 200 mW/cm2 in text; title says stainless steel, text and F7d say mild steel; F5 caption says 1, 30, 60 days but text reports 100-day values; F6 caption garbled.
